purpose: EVALUATION ONLY. FieldResolver inference must never import, read or reference this file. Fixed before any FieldResolver implementation exists.

observationMethod.description: Each sample page was rendered to an image (pdftoppm, 130 dpi full page; 220 dpi crops for dense or low-confidence cells) and read visually by the assistant (an AI), not by a human. Values come from the rendered page only: no extracted text, no neighbouring-value arithmetic, no general knowledge. Cells that could not be read are not recorded as values. Where an existing human coordinate anchor exists (human-observations.json) it is referenced.
observationMethod.pageSelectionNote: The four core pages are the existing Golden Sample locators. METI p10, p96, p105 and こども家庭庁 p136 were added for field-behaviour boundaries; p96/p105/p136 were found using extraction output as a SEARCH aid only (candidate pages), and their values were then read from the rendered page.
observationMethod.hierarchyInputStates: The hierarchy.inputState fields record the state in the frozen DocumentHierarchy B-only artifact (derived input, regenerable). They are inputs to the Contract policy, not visual truth. Hierarchy-dependent expected statuses are policy-derived (Contract section 9).
